identity.limits: Context IDs identify ordered contexts, not necessarily unique question wordings, tokenization, or execution settings. Positional-only comparisons assume the same ordered prompts; the tensor artifacts cannot verify that assumption.

definitions.footprint: present state minus absent state for each prompt
definitions.midpoint: mean of the two condition states for each prompt
definitions.bit_identical: All bytes of each finite floating element match, including zero sign
definitions.norm: Euclidean norm computed on CPU after conversion to float64

scope: Descriptive comparison of one fitted/fresh compilation pair on fixed prompts. No population CIs, detector performance, or repeated-compilation variance are estimated.
